phases.title: Complete Engineering Review
entryCriteria: Calculations and assumptions have named scope, formula or model basis.
exitCriteria: All calculation and assumption review rows are accepted, revised or explicitly deferred with reviewer rationale.
phases.rationale: Deterministic arithmetic can expose claims, but engineering judgment must review envelopes, assumptions and operating cases.
